**Sundhedsklyngen SUH** refers to the health cluster centered around Sjællands Universitetshospital (SUH). It is one of the localized healthcare clusters in Denmark evaluated in the national quality monitoring program for the treatment of [[atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation). The cluster's performance is tracked across multiple clinical quality indicators to ensure adherence to national treatment guidelines and to benchmark regional care quality.

A key area of evaluation is the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy. Sundhedsklyngen SUH meets the national standard for Indicator 1, achieving a compliance rate of 91.5% for the timely start of treatment in newly diagnosed patients [^src1]. The cluster is also assessed on long-term treatment coverage, including 1-year, 2-year, and 5-year anticoagulation adherence [^src2] [^src3], as well as routine monitoring practices like annual P-creatinine measurements for patients on DOACs [^src4]. 

Beyond treatment coverage, the cluster's patient outcomes are closely monitored. This includes tracking the incidence of ischemic stroke ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src4], severe bleeding within one year of a new diagnosis (Indicator 11), and the development of heart failure within one year (Indicator 15) [^src6]. The data also encompasses mortality rates and broader epidemiological implications for cardiovascular care [^src7].

In the hierarchical reporting structure of the national registry, Sundhedsklyngen SUH's metrics are compared against national and regional benchmarks. In certain data tables, it is listed in association with regional aggregations such as [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src5]. Furthermore, the cluster is included in national geographic mappings (Danmarkskort) that visualize the incidence of stroke across all Danish health clusters, placing its outcomes in a broad national context alongside clusters like [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]], [[sundhedsklynge-byen|Sundhedsklynge Byen]], and [[aarhusklyngen|Aarhusklyngen]] [^src4].
